backend/main.mo: Motoko canister with access-controlled user profiles and a public inquiry submission system storing inquiries and allowing admin retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping product features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each frontend file's purpose across layout, pages, auth, hooks, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base file defining OKLCH color variables, themes, and global background/foreground styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component switching between marketing and admin inquiries views with header and footer.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button handling auth state, errors, and React Query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAdmi: Wrapper enforcing admin authorization and showing loading or access-denied UI when appropriate.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Authentication guard requiring Internet Identity login before rendering protected content.
frontend/src/components/forms/InquiryFor: Inquiry submission form with validation, field state management, and mutation to send inquiries.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Footer displaying copyright, branding, and a caffeine.ai attribution with heart icon.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Responsive site header with navigation, mobile menu, section scrolling, and admin view toggle.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Renders the About section with company values, descriptions, and a highlight card.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Displays contact info and an inquiry form with a success state after submission.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Hero banner featuring company branding, intro text, and buttons scrolling to services or contact.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a grid of service cards describing the company's main offerings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query wrappers for submitting inquiries, fetching inquiries, and checking admin status.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base/styles plus custom OKLCH CSS variables defining a pink‑and‑gold theme for light and dark mode.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/InquiriesPage.tsx: Admin‑protected page that fetches and displays all contact inquiries with loading, error, and table views.
frontend/src/pages/MarketingPage.tsx: Composes the public marketing layout by rendering hero, services, about, and contact sections.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using URLSearchParams and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending fonts, colors, animations, and theme tokens using the pink‑and‑gold CSS variables.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing site requirements, features, outstanding requests, and branding image needs.
